method.description: Every valid pair is forced BUY or SELL. Each pair chooses one of three predeclared low-complexity models using development-only evidence: BALANCED cross-currency+trend, STRUCTURE-first, or ADX REGIME-adaptive. Minimal indicators: EMA20/50, RSI14, ATR14, ADX14 plus 6h/24h/72h cross-currency strength. SL is recent M15 structural invalidation with ATR/realized-range floor/cap. TP is prior 24h/72h directional liquidity when realistic, otherwise trailing realized daily-range projection. No fixed RR target. MARKET and adaptive pullback LIMIT are both evaluated. Direction is separately scored at 6h/12h/24h.
